_**Agent (claude-opus-5-5 2026-10-08 09:29:53Z)**_

The push worked. `main` is now on https://github.com/Shifana1/Employee_attendance and set to track `origin/main`.

**Why it failed:** git's default HTTP post buffer is 1 MB, and your push was 1.06 MiB. Above that limit git sends the upload in chunks, and GitHub sometimes rejects those over HTTP/2 with a 400. The "Everything up-to-date" line was misleading: nothing had actually been pushed.

**Fix:** I changed two settings, for this repo only:
```
git config http.postBuffer 524288000   # 500 MB buffer
git config http.version HTTP/1.1
```

If other repos hit the same error, run the same two commands with `--global`.
